tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Use when you deployed or edited a page and need to catch visual regressions and content changes: it compares the live URL with a baseline captured on the first call, a snapshot or a production URL, and answers the regressions. Free up to 100 pages per client address per day, no key needed.

tools.name: diff_deploy
tools.description: Use when a staging or preview deploy should match production, or a migrated site its old one: it compares the pages of both origins and answers only the pages that are missing, changed or look different. Free up to 100 pages per client address per day, no key needed.

tools.name: wait_for_comparison
tools.description: Waits until the job is completed, failed or cancelled, or timeoutSeconds pass, then answers status, progress and, once terminal, the summary (passed, failed, issuesBySeverity). On "running", call it again. Free.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The finished report. Call it first with failedOnly: true and view: "digest": only the failed pages, each with its issues, diff percentage and largest regions, and a text line per page; summary covers every page. check_page and diff_deploy return the first regressed region's image; get_screenshot (?s

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Takes a full-page screenshot of one URL, for example to see how a relaunched page or a mobile layout looks. Free 10 times per client address per day, no key needed. findings.detail: Description of "get_balance" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
